metadata.description: Current DOCX generation, extraction, accessibility, and interoperability sources for Word workflows.
metadata.title: Document DOCX - Sources

python_libraries.name: python-docx Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Primary reference for creating and editing .docx files in Python. Comments support (Document.add_comment) requires v1.2.0+; verify installed version before promising it.

python_libraries.name: docxtpl Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Template-driven DOCX generation in Python for Word-authored layouts and mail-merge-style automation.

nodejs_and_html_conversion.name: docx Documentation
nodejs_and_html_conversion.relevance: Primary usage documentation for generating .docx documents in Node.js/TypeScript.

nodejs_and_html_conversion.name: docx npm Package
nodejs_and_html_conversion.relevance: Canonical package page for current published version, install metadata, and release recency.

nodejs_and_html_conversion.name: mammoth.js
nodejs_and_html_conversion.relevance: Semantic DOCX-to-HTML conversion; important for extraction workflows and security caveats around unsanitized output.

llm_and_extraction_workflows.name: Docling Supported Formats
llm_and_extraction_workflows.relevance: Current supported-format matrix for multi-format document ingestion and structured extraction.

llm_and_extraction_workflows.name: Docling (IBM Research) — GitHub
llm_and_extraction_workflows.relevance: Production document-extraction library (IBM Research) producing structured DoclingDocument from DOCX, PDF, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, and images. Primary source for releases, issue tracking, and integration examples.

llm_and_extraction_workflows.name: Mistral OCR
llm_and_extraction_workflows.relevance: OCR API understanding text, tables, equations, and embedded media across document formats including DOCX-derived images; ~1000 pages per dollar. Docs at https://docs.mistral.ai/

llm_and_extraction_workflows.name: MarkItDown
llm_and_extraction_workflows.relevance: Markdown-focused conversion pipeline from Microsoft, useful for LLM/RAG-friendly extraction from DOCX.

quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.name: Make Your Word Documents Accessible (Microsoft Support)
quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.relevance: Baseline accessibility practices for Word documents, including headings, tables, alt text, and checker usage.

quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.name: W3C WAI - European Union
quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.relevance: Useful for current context on EU accessibility law and which WCAG version is currently referenced by EN 301 549.

quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.name: Office Open XML (ECMA-376)
quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.relevance: Underlying standard behind .docx; useful for interoperability edge cases and OOXML-level work.

quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.name: Open XML SDK (Microsoft Learn)
quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.relevance: Primary Microsoft documentation for low-level OOXML manipulation in .NET.

quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.name: DocumentFormat.OpenXml (NuGet)
quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.relevance: Canonical package page for current Open XML SDK release version and install metadata.

quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.name: docx4j Releases
quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.relevance: Current release stream for docx4j/docx4java, preferable to the older trac site for version checks.

quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.name: docx2pdf
quality_interoperability_and_accessibili.relevance: Current project documentation for Word-based DOCX-to-PDF conversion on Windows/macOS.
